timeline.keyMonuments: Udayagiri Caves (Cave 5 Varaha), Nachna Kuthara, Deogarh Dashavatara, Ajanta & Elephanta Caves
timeline.description: Establishment of canonical iconography, proportional canons (Talamana), and the transition from free-standing wood/brick shrines to stone carving.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Subtle modeling of anatomical contours, diaphanous clinging garments, spiritual serenity with downcast contemplative eyes.

timeline.era: Early Medieval Rock-Cut Genesis (Pallava & Early Chalukya)
timeline.dynasties: Pallavas of Kanchipuram, Early Western Chalukyas of Badami
timeline.keyMonuments: Mamallapuram (Arjuna's Penance, Pancha Rathas), Badami Cave Temples, Aihole Durga Temple, Pattadakal Virupaksha
timeline.description: Monumental stone carving in open-air boulders and cave shrines. Transition from rock excavation to structural stone masonry.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Slender, naturalistic human forms in granite; narrative bas-reliefs integrated with natural landscapes; early synthesis of northern and southern styles.

timeline.era: Monolithic Grandeur & Zenith of Rock Architecture (Rashtrakuta)
timeline.keyMonuments: Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) at Ellora, Elephanta Trimurti
timeline.description: Carving entire multi-story temple complexes out of living basalt mountains from the summit downward.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Dramatic chiaroscuro with deep undercut shadows, heroic proportions, dynamic foreshortening, and monumental narrative scenes.

timeline.era: Imperial Splendor & Metallurgical Mastery (Chola Golden Age)
timeline.dynasties: Imperial Cholas of Thanjavur & Gangaikonda Cholapuram
timeline.keyMonuments: Brihadisvara Temple (Thanjavur), Airavatesvara Temple (Darasuram), Chidambaram Nataraja
timeline.description: Granite Vimanas soaring over 60 meters and perfection of lost-wax cire-perdue cast bronzes for mobile temple processions.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Madhuchishtavidhana bronze casting, kinetic balance of Anandatandava pose, crisp granite niche carvings.

timeline.era: Nagara Curvilinear Heights & Sensuous Elegance (Chandela & Solanki)
timeline.dynasties: Chandela Dynasty of Jejakabhukti, Solankis of Gujarat
timeline.keyMonuments: Kandariya Mahadeva & Lakshmana Temples (Khajuraho), Sun Temple (Modhera), Rani ki Vav (Patan)
timeline.description: Complex clustering of mini-spires (Urushringas) creating rhythmic mountain silhouettes; celebration of cosmic abundance through Mithuna and Surasundari figures.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Supple Tribhanga poses in warm buff sandstone, exquisite details of jewelry, musical instruments, and textiles.

timeline.keyMonuments: Lingaraja Temple (Bhubaneswar), Jagannath Temple (Puri), Konark Sun Temple
timeline.description: Integration of the Rekha Deula sanctum tower with stepped Pidhi Jagamohana halls and monumental celestial chariot designs.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: High polish on dark green chlorite, monumental stone wheels functioning as solar sundials, expressive musician maidens.

timeline.keyMonuments: Belur Chennakeshava, Halebidu Hoysaleswara, Somanathapura, Ramappa Temple (Palampet)
timeline.description: Star-shaped ground plans and micro-carving in soft soapstone that allowed sculptors to sign their individual creations; mirror-polished dolerite and lightweight floating bricks.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Pierced openwork, rotatable stone beads, lace-like bracket maidens (Madanikas), and mirror sheen polish.

timeline.dynasties: Vijayanagara Empire, Nayakas of Madurai, Thanjavur & Gingee
timeline.keyMonuments: Hampi Vittala & Virupaksha, Lepakshi Veerabhadra, Meenakshi Amman (Madurai), Srirangam Ranganathaswamy
timeline.description: Expansive thousand-pillared halls (Ayirakkal Mandapa), acoustic musical columns, colossal monolithic Nandis, and rearing Yali columns.
timeline.sculpturalTechnique: Virtuosic carving of hard grey granite, kinetic rearing mythical beasts, and monumental gopuram stucco reliefs.
